## Contributing

#### Feature Requests

Feature requests and general questions belong in the
[Discussions](https://github.com/jalexiscv/higgs-mythos/discussions) section of
the repository.

#### Bug Reports

Please file reproducible bugs as GitHub issues, including the Higgs Mythos
version, the affected module(s), the platform and a minimal reproduction. Use
the issue templates in `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE` when possible.

Security issues must follow [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md) instead of a public
issue.

#### Pull Requests

- Keep each change focused, and describe what it fixes or adds.
- Build the affected targets and run the unit tests before opening the PR.
- Code, comments and commit messages are written in English.
- By submitting a pull request you agree to license your contribution under the
  same terms as the project (AGPL-3.0-or-later), and you confirm that you wrote
  the code or have the right to submit it.
- Do not include code copied from proprietary binaries or from sources whose
  licence is incompatible with the AGPL.
